title: BUGFIX — findCaptionedMp4 misses v2-output videos: /deliver can't serve 11 ready MP4s
rationale: findCaptionedMp4 in shared.ts scans run-*/caption/ and multiformat-runs/mf-*/output/ but NOT v2-output/<id>/<id>.mp4. Result: 11 v2-format videos with MP4 files on disk are invisible to /deliver, /queue (ready check), and /pickup. Fix: add v2-output scan as 3rd lookup path in findCaptionedMp4.

tasks.description: In scripts/telegram-commands/shared.ts, extend findCaptionedMp4() to also check workspace/scs001/v2-output/<videoId>/<videoId>.mp4 as a 3rd search path. Add after the multiformat-runs block.
